area: Mission Center GIS explorer (statewide Event Groups -> incidents -> evidence). Audited files: web/src/features/missionCenter/MissionCenterProjectExplorer.tsx (page + aside), web/src/features/missionCenter/MissionCenterProjectGisMap.tsx (ArcGIS map + legend), web/src/features/missionCenter/missionCenterGisModel.ts, web/src/components/mapTheme.ts, web/src/components/MissionCenterMap.tsx (unrouted legacy), plus the delegated UI modules web/src/ui/AppShell.tsx, web/src/features/incidents/incidentClassification.ts and web/src/features/submissions/photoEvidenceApi.ts. Inventory verified; two corrections: (1) the 'Loading Event Group…' / 'was not found' copy at Explorer.tsx:390 is practically unreachable because mode only leaves PROJECTS after the detail fetch succeeds (122-126), so a deep link shows the statewide toolbar + list + California extent until the group loads; (2) 'Loading GIS evidence…' at Explorer.tsx:342 never renders during the initial incident load because the INCIDENT block (331) requires incidentGis to already match the route, and the fallback at 391 is hidden while loadingEvidence is true.

heuristicIssues.issue: The map viewport is reset to the full California extent on every 60 s poll and on every search keystroke or status change, discarding the user's pan/zoom while they are scanning the map.
heuristicIssues.evidence: Explorer.tsx:148 (setEventGroups creates a new array), 157-161 (60 s setInterval), 203-207 (useMemo derives a fresh visibleMapProjects on every eventGroupSearch/eventGroupStatus change) -> GisMap.tsx:229-263 effect deps [mode, projects, selectedProjectId] with view.goTo(CALIFORNIA_EXTENT, { duration: 0 }) at line 262.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Split the effect: rebuild graphics when projects change but only call goTo when mode changes (track previous mode in a ref). When a filter narrows the set, goTo the filtered graphics' extent instead of California; on the poll, diff by id and leave the viewpoint alone.

heuristicIssues.screen: Statewide Event Groups and Event Group drill-down (map)
heuristicIssues.issue: Clicking/tapping a marker navigates immediately in the same click handler that ArcGIS uses to open the popup, so the popup ('Click the marker to inspect…') is dead copy and there is no way to peek at a group or incident without leaving the current level; on touch, a mis-tap on an 11-14 px marker in a cluster changes the route.
heuristicIssues.evidence: GisMap.tsx:196-214 (view.on('click') -> hitTest -> onSelectProject/onSelectIncident), 251 (11/14 px circles), 255-258 and 295-298 (popup templates with 'Click the marker…' text).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Make the first click open the popup and put an explicit 'Open Event Group' / 'Inspect evidence' action button in the popup (popupTemplate.actions or a custom content element); navigate only from that action. Remove the instruction sentence. Enlarge hit tolerance for touch (view.hitTest with a tolerance option or larger symbols below md).

heuristicIssues.screen: Event Group drill-down (/mission-center/:gid) via deep link or breadcrumb
heuristicIssues.issue: While the group detail loads, mode stays PROJECTS, so the page shows the statewide search toolbar, the full Event Group list and a California-extent map for a URL that names one group; the 'Loading Event Group…' copy is unreachable in this path, and the view then jumps twice (statewide goTo, then fit-to-incidents) with duration 0.
heuristicIssues.evidence: Explorer.tsx:122-126 (mode PROJECT requires eventGroupDetail?.event_group.id === selectedEventGroupId), 240 (toolbar rendered when mode === 'PROJECTS'), 287 (statewide list), 390 (loading copy gated on mode !== 'PROJECTS' && !selectedEventGroup); GisMap.tsx:262 and 304 (two goTo calls with duration 0).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Derive mode from the route (selectedEventGroupId/selectedIncidentId) rather than from loaded data, and render a skeleton/'Loading Event Group #12…' aside plus a breadcrumb immediately. Skip the statewide goTo when the route already targets a group.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors
heuristicIssues.issue: Any failure of the /event-groups/:id fetch nulls eventGroupDetail, which collapses mode to PROJECTS: the statewide list appears under a group URL with only a banner, and the next 60 s poll calls setError(null) and removes the banner, leaving the user on the wrong view with no explanation and no retry.
heuristicIssues.evidence: Explorer.tsx:181-182 (setError + setEventGroupDetail(null)), 122-126 (mode falls back to PROJECTS), 135 (loadEventGroups clears the shared error slot), 157-161 (poll).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Keep separate error state per fetch (groups / detail / evidence), render an in-aside error card with a Retry button for the failed level, and never let a background poll clear a foreground error.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors
heuristicIssues.issue: When the incident GIS loads but the incident is not in the group's incident list (or the detail fetch failed while the group is in the statewide list), mode becomes INCIDENT yet the INCIDENT block requires selectedIncident, so the aside renders empty: neither fallback message matches (390 needs !selectedEventGroup, 391 needs mode === 'PROJECT').
heuristicIssues.evidence: Explorer.tsx:122-123 (mode INCIDENT checks only incidentGis), 220-221 (selectedIncident from eventGroupDetail.incidents), 331 (block requires selectedIncident && incidentGis && selectedEventGroup), 390-391.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Render the INCIDENT header from incidentGis.incident (it already carries id/title/status) so the block never depends on the group's incident list; add a final catch-all aside state 'Incident #{iid} could not be shown' with links back to the group.

heuristicIssues.issue: Incident cards show 'Loading classification…' permanently when /incident-classifications/query fails or omits an incident, so a failure reads as an in-progress load; the same string appears in the marker popup attributes.
heuristicIssues.evidence: incidentClassification.ts:18-19 (undefined -> 'Loading classification…'); Explorer.tsx:174-177 (single POST, no per-incident fallback), 324; GisMap.tsx:285.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Track classification load state explicitly (loading | loaded | failed) and show 'Classification unavailable' with a retry when failed; show 'Unclassified' when the response omits an incident.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Match between system and the real world
heuristicIssues.issue: Evidence-integrity fields a reviewer needs to verify a photo (location_overridden, heading_overridden, horizontal_accuracy_m, location_source, heading_source) are fetched but never shown, so a corrected heading looks identical to a device heading.
heuristicIssues.evidence: photoEvidenceApi.ts:3-30 (PhotoEvidence.correction, horizontal_accuracy_m, location_source, heading_source); Explorer.tsx:381 renders only Mapped/Unmapped, heading, captured_at; GisMap.tsx:331-334 popup omits them too.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Add a small 'Corrected' pill on rows where correction.location_overridden || heading_overridden, and '±{n} m' accuracy next to 'Mapped'; include the same in the popup content.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Match between system and the real world
heuristicIssues.issue: Raw codes leak into the UI: marker popups print 'Status: OPEN' / 'IN_PROGRESS' while the cards say 'Open' / 'In progress'; the photo popup prints the raw ISO captured_at while the list formats it; the facts grid shows 'Saved geometry: MultiPolygon'.
heuristicIssues.evidence: GisMap.tsx:243 and 257 (status attribute + popup), 284 and 297, 333 (escapeHtml(photo.captured_at)); Explorer.tsx:346 (geometry.type), vs 70-74 formatTimestamp and 76-78 incidentStatusLabel.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Pass humanized labels into graphic attributes (eventGroupStatusLabel / incidentStatusLabel / formatTimestamp) and replace the geometry type with 'Affected area drawn' / 'Line drawn' / 'Not drawn'.

heuristicIssues.issue: Legend is incomplete in every mode: statewide omits the slate Closed and light-slate Archived colours; group level omits the orange In-progress diamond and calls the red one 'Active'; incident level omits the selected-incident diamond that stays on the map. Colour is the only status encoding on the map.
heuristicIssues.evidence: GisMap.tsx:63-67 (three group colours), 69-73 (three incident colours), 272-274 (selected incident kept in INCIDENT mode), 377-379 (legend chips).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Generate legend chips from the same colour functions (statusProjectColor/incidentColor) so they cannot drift; add 'Selected Incident' to the INCIDENT legend.

heuristicIssues.issue: Two counts with no stated relationship: the toolbar totals are computed over all groups while the aside says '{n} shown on map' for the filtered set; a user who filters to Open sees '412 Event Groups · 130 open' next to '130 shown on map'.
heuristicIssues.evidence: Explorer.tsx:213-218 (summary over eventGroups), 252, 291 (visibleGroups.length).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Show one line: '{visible} of {total} Event Groups shown · {open} open · {active} active Incidents', and place it in the aside header only.

heuristicIssues.issue: One screen is named five ways ('Mission Center' h1, 'California Event Groups' breadcrumb root, 'Event Groups' aside, '← All California Event Groups', '← Event Group Incidents'); the same destination is 'Open full Event Group workspace' at group level and 'Open Event Group' at incident level; the '{n} incidents' pill is lowercase while every other label says 'Incidents'; the toolbar mixes 'open' (groups) with 'active' (incidents).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Adopt one vocabulary: breadcrumb root 'Mission Center', aside heading 'Event Groups', a single 'Open Event Group workspace' label, capitalized 'Incidents' everywhere, and 'active' for both groups and incidents (or 'open' for both).

heuristicIssues.screen: Event Group drill-down and Incident evidence (pills)
heuristicIssues.issue: The 'bad' (red) tone is used for an ordinary count ('3 active') and for New/In progress incident status, so every non-resolved incident reads as an error; the same active count is neutral text on the statewide cards.
heuristicIssues.evidence: Explorer.tsx:314 (tone={open_incident_count > 0 ? 'bad' : 'good'}), 322 and 337 (tone={status === 'RESOLVED' ? 'good' : 'bad'}) vs 299 (plain text).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Use the 'brand' or a warning tone for active counts and In progress, red only for New (matching the map's red diamond), and neutral for counts.

heuristicIssues.screen: Incident GIS evidence (transition from group level)
heuristicIssues.issue: Drilling into an incident gives no loading feedback: mode stays PROJECT while incidentGis loads, the fallback at 391 is hidden while loadingEvidence is true, and 'Loading GIS evidence…' (342) only renders once incidentGis already matches the route.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Show a loading state on the clicked incident card (or in the aside header) while loadingEvidence is true, and drive mode from the route.

heuristicIssues.issue: A photo row is one button with two very different outcomes (move the map, or open a new browser tab); the difference is conveyed only by a hover title tooltip. A mapped photo whose graphic is not on the map (focusPhoto returns false, e.g. map still initializing) silently falls through to window.open with no notice.
heuristicIssues.evidence: Explorer.tsx:372-376 (branching), 378 (title attribute), 375 (window.open unconditionally after the branch).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Render a visible affordance per row ('Show on map' vs 'Open file' with an external-link icon), disable the map action until the layer has the graphic, and show the notice for the fall-through case as well.

heuristicIssues.issue: The ArcGIS Home widget stores the initial California viewpoint, so pressing Home while inspecting an incident's photos jumps to the statewide extent; all three auto-recentres use duration 0 so they feel like glitches rather than transitions.
heuristicIssues.evidence: GisMap.tsx:186 (new Home({ view }) at mount), 262, 304, 367 (duration: 0).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Set home.viewpoint after each mode's goTo (group extent / incident extent) and use a short animation (duration 300-500 ms) except for the initial render.

heuristicIssues.issue: Filtering does not change the map framing: searching 'D4' or 'Humboldt' leaves the map at the statewide extent with a handful of markers, and there is no 'fit to results' action; conversely there is no incident-level search once drilled in, so large groups become a long unfiltered list.
heuristicIssues.evidence: GisMap.tsx:262 (goTo CALIFORNIA_EXTENT on every projects change); Explorer.tsx:240 (toolbar only in PROJECTS mode), 320-326 (unfiltered incident list).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: After a filter change goTo the filtered graphics' extent (fall back to California when empty); reuse the search input at group level to filter incidents by id/title/location/classification.

heuristicIssues.issue: The search input and status select have no accessible label (placeholder only); the placeholder advertises county/route/post mile although the matcher also covers id, title and description; the ArcGIS Expand tooltip 'Search map' (geocoder) sits on the same screen as the app's search with a different meaning.
heuristicIssues.evidence: Explorer.tsx:243-244 (no <label>/aria-label); missionCenterGisModel.ts:66-79 (haystack fields); GisMap.tsx:189-192.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Add aria-label='Search Event Groups' and 'Filter by status'; change the placeholder to 'Search by title, #id, county, route or post mile'; rename the ArcGIS tooltip to 'Find a place'.

heuristicIssues.issue: The breadcrumb is a div with <b> for the current item (no <nav aria-label='Breadcrumb'>, no aria-current); section labels ('Event Groups', 'Associated Incidents', 'Photo evidence') are styled divs, not headings; loading, notice and empty states have no aria-live; the map container has an aria-label but no role.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Use <nav aria-label='Breadcrumb'> with aria-current='page'; h2/h3 for section labels; aria-live='polite' on the aside status area; role='region' on the map wrapper.

heuristicIssues.heuristic: Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors
heuristicIssues.issue: Maintenance-only accounts reaching a shared /mission-center link get a two-sentence explanation with no next step, under a page title for a page they cannot use; sibling operational pages redirect via RoleRoute instead, so behaviour differs by route.
heuristicIssues.evidence: Explorer.tsx:225-235 (inline notice, no link); AppShell.tsx:84 (nav entry hidden); inventory notes RoleRoute is used for /event-groups and /assessments in web/src/App.tsx.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Either wrap the routes in RoleRoute for consistency, or keep the notice and add 'Go to Incidents' / 'Go to My Work' buttons.

heuristicIssues.screen: Event Group drill-down and Incident evidence (aside header)
heuristicIssues.issue: Redundant chrome above the list: a '← All California Event Groups' / '← Event Group Incidents' button duplicates the breadcrumb two rows up; the 'Selected Event Group' eyebrow restates the breadcrumb; the group location appears both at the right of the breadcrumb and under the title; at incident level the breadcrumb's right-hand label is the group's location, not the incident's.
heuristicIssues.evidence: Explorer.tsx:260 vs 310, 262 vs 334, 264 vs 313, 311; 264 uses eventGroupLocationLabel(selectedEventGroup) in INCIDENT mode.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Remove the back buttons and the eyebrow; show location once (under the title); at incident level show the incident's location label in the breadcrumb.

heuristicIssues.issue: The LayerList always exposes all five graphics layers ('Event Groups', 'Event Group incidents', 'Saved incident geometry', 'Camera headings', 'Field photos') even when four are empty, so toggling them does nothing visible.
heuristicIssues.evidence: GisMap.tsx:166-170 (titles), 191 (LayerList over the whole map), 233-234/269-270/317-320 (layers emptied per mode).
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Set layer.listMode = 'hide' for layers not used by the current mode, or drop the LayerList and keep only the basemap gallery.

heuristicIssues.issue: A group with no incidents centres an empty map at zoom 13 with no on-map message; the only hint is the aside's 'No Incidents are associated…' text, which is below the fold on stacked layouts.
heuristicIssues.evidence: GisMap.tsx:305 (goTo group centroid, zoom 13); Explorer.tsx:326.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Draw the group centroid marker in PROJECT mode and overlay a small 'No Incidents in this Event Group' chip on the map.

heuristicIssues.issue: 'Updated Sep 5, 2026, 2:14 PM' spends ~26 characters on a full date for a feed refreshed every minute, and the poll runs (fetching up to 100 pages) while the tab is hidden or while the user is drilled into an incident where the layer is not drawn.
heuristicIssues.evidence: Explorer.tsx:17-23 (formatter), 254, 139-147, 157-161; GisMap.tsx:234.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Show 'Updated 2 min ago' with the full timestamp in a title; pause the interval when document.hidden or mode !== 'PROJECTS'.

heuristicIssues.issue: Four button sizes on one page: 11 px back buttons, 12 px Refresh, 14 px btn/btnPrimary, and full-width card buttons; the local btn strings differ from other pages' definitions and the .btn-brand utility is unused.
heuristicIssues.recommendation: Use one shared Button component with sm/md sizes; delete the local btn strings.

responsiveIssues.issue: Search + status select overflow and are clipped at 375 px: the toolbar's inner width is about 277 px (shell px-4, page p-4, toolbar px-4) but the grid has a 220 px input floor plus an auto-width select (~105 px) and an 8 px gap (~333 px); the AppShell product-card is overflow-hidden, so the right edge of the select is cut off rather than scrollable.
responsiveIssues.evidence: Explorer.tsx:242 ('grid max-w-[560px] flex-[1_1_340px] grid-cols-[minmax(220px,1fr)_auto] gap-2'); AppShell.tsx:163 (px-4), 185 (overflow-hidden); Explorer.tsx:239 (p-4), 241 (px-4).
responsiveIssues.fix: Change to 'grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_auto] gap-2 w-full sm:max-w-[560px]' and give the select 'min-w-0'. Stack the summary/refresh row under it below sm.

responsiveIssues.issue: The map is forced to at least 540 px tall (clamp floor) and sits above the aside; with the AppShell's stacked 'Navigation' card (~400-460 px for an operational user), header, h1 and toolbar, the Event Group list starts roughly 1,300 px down an 812 px viewport, and ArcGIS captures single-finger drag for panning, so scrolling past the map is unreliable.
responsiveIssues.evidence: Explorer.tsx:283 (height='clamp(540px, calc(100vh - 320px), 900px)'), 271 (single-column below xl), 286 (aside); AppShell.tsx:164 (nav card for <lg), 163 (py-6).
responsiveIssues.fix: Pass a responsive height: below md use 'clamp(280px, 42vh, 420px)'; add a sticky 'Map | List' segmented toggle at the top of the page below xl so only one panel is shown; collapse the AppShell nav card into a disclosure (<details>) or a top bar with a menu button on <lg.

responsiveIssues.issue: The aside has its own max-h-[760px] overflow-auto region nested inside the page scroll, producing scroll-trapping on touch, and the card list inside it is the only keyboard-accessible route to the map data.
responsiveIssues.evidence: Explorer.tsx:286 ('flex max-h-[760px] flex-col overflow-hidden'), 293/318/341 (overflow-auto inner panels).
responsiveIssues.fix: Below xl remove the max-height and inner scrolling (let the page scroll: 'xl:max-h-[760px] xl:overflow-hidden' and 'xl:overflow-auto' on the inner panel).

responsiveIssues.screen: Event Group drill-down and Incident evidence (aside header)
responsiveIssues.issue: Back buttons are text-[11px] px-2 py-1 (~22 px tall) and Refresh is px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs (~28 px), below the 44 px touch guideline; StatusPills are 11 px text.
responsiveIssues.fix: Remove the back buttons (breadcrumb covers them) or give every button min-h-11 on touch ('min-h-11 md:min-h-0'); raise pill text to 12 px.

responsiveIssues.issue: The <dl> is a fixed grid-cols-2 with no breakpoint; at ~277 px inner width each column is ~135 px and '38.123456, -121.123456' (text-sm font-medium, ~175 px) wraps in the middle of a coordinate.
responsiveIssues.fix: Use 'grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2' and render the coordinate on two lines (lat / lng) with a copy button.

responsiveIssues.issue: Photo popups embed an image up to 320 px wide inside a ~309 px-wide map with dockEnabled:false, so the popup can exceed the map card and cover all markers; with dock disabled ArcGIS will not fall back to a bottom sheet.
responsiveIssues.fix: Enable docking with breakpoint rules: popup: { dockEnabled: true, dockOptions: { breakpoint: { width: 768 }, position: 'bottom-center', buttonEnabled: false } }; set the popup image to max-width:100%.

responsiveIssues.issue: Markers are 11-14 px circles and 10-13 px diamonds with a single tap that navigates; adjacent incidents in one group cannot be tapped distinctly and there is no hover preview on touch.
responsiveIssues.fix: Below md enlarge symbols by ~1.5x and use the popup-first pattern (see heuristic issue on dead popups); consider clustering via a FeatureLayer with featureReduction for the statewide layer.

responsiveIssues.screen: Incident GIS evidence (photo row -> map sync)
responsiveIssues.issue: Below xl (1280 px) map and evidence list are stacked; tapping a photo row moves the map that is off-screen above, and nothing scrolls the map into view, so the feature's core interaction is invisible on both tablet orientations.
responsiveIssues.fix: After a successful focusPhoto call divRef.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start', behavior: 'smooth' }) when window.matchMedia('(max-width: 1279px)').matches, or adopt the Map | List toggle and switch to the map on focus.

responsiveIssues.issue: On a 1024x768 landscape tablet the sidebar (lg) appears but the two-column grid does not (xl), so the map is 540 px tall (clamp floor) in a ~656 px-wide column and, with the sticky header, h1 and toolbar, it ends at the bottom edge of the viewport; the list starts entirely off-screen. On 768x1024 portrait the map grows to 704 px and the nav card stacks above it.
responsiveIssues.fix: Lower the two-column breakpoint to lg with a narrower aside ('lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.4fr)_minmax(300px,1fr)]') and cap the map at 'calc(100vh - 220px)' in that band.

responsiveIssues.issue: The summary + 'Updated …' + Refresh cluster is ml-auto in a flex-wrap row; when it wraps under the search grid at 768-1024 px it becomes a left-aligned second row with the Refresh button in the middle of the text.
responsiveIssues.fix: Make the right cluster its own flex row with 'w-full md:w-auto justify-between' and place Refresh at its end.

responsiveIssues.issue: At 1440x900 the map is ~716 px wide and 580 px tall while the aside caps at 760 px, so the two columns end at different heights (items-start) and the aside scrolls independently; at 1900 px the map is ~1100 px wide but popups remain undocked and small.
responsiveIssues.fix: Give both columns the same height token (e.g. --panel-h: clamp(540px, calc(100vh - 320px), 900px)) and use it for the map wrapper and the aside max-height.

responsiveIssues.issue: Expand buttons are icon-only with hover tooltips ('Search map', 'Basemaps', 'GIS layers'); on touch there is no tooltip, and on a 309 px-wide phone map five 32 px widgets crowd the top edge and the expanded Search widget is wider than the map.
responsiveIssues.fix: Below md add only Home and one Expand grouping the three tools (Expand with group:'top-right' collapses siblings), or drop Search/LayerList on phones.

dataDensity.reason: Primary way to locate a group by title/id/county/route/post mile (Explorer.tsx:243).
Open/Closed/Archived is the main triage filter and drives both map and list (Explorer.tsx:244-249).
Useful pulse but it competes with '{n} shown on map'; merge into one line in the aside header (Explorer.tsx:252, 291).
Feed auto-refreshes every 60 s; a relative time and a small icon button at the end of the aside header suffice (Explorer.tsx:254-255).
The map is the point of the screen; colour = status, size = activity (GisMap.tsx:236-260).
Make the popup the first-click preview with an explicit Open action; remove the instruction sentence (GisMap.tsx:255-258).
Needed to decode colour/size, but must list all three status colours (GisMap.tsx:377).
What the user scans for and the main triage attribute (Explorer.tsx:297).
The id is only useful for cross-reference; keep the location label, move the id to the end in muted text (Explorer.tsx:298).
Activity decides which group to open; shorten to '{n} Incidents · {m} active' (Explorer.tsx:299).
Occasional GIS chrome; keep behind one grouped Expand, hide LayerList layers that are empty in the current mode (GisMap.tsx:189-194).
Only wayfinding across the three levels (Explorer.tsx:259-265).
Duplicates the breadcrumb link (Explorer.tsx:310 vs 260).
Restates the breadcrumb; adds a row above the fold on stacked layouts (Explorer.tsx:311).
Identifies the group and its activity; fix casing and tone (Explorer.tsx:312-314).
Location is already at the breadcrumb's right edge; show it once, id in muted text (Explorer.tsx:313 vs 264).
Free text not needed to pick an incident; show two lines with 'More' (Explorer.tsx:315).
Only route to history/assessments for the group (Explorer.tsx:316).

dataDensity.element: Incident card: #id + title, status pill, location, classification
dataDensity.reason: All four are the triage attributes for choosing an incident (Explorer.tsx:322-324).
Same preview-then-open pattern as the group popup (GisMap.tsx:295-298).
Duplicates the breadcrumb group link (Explorer.tsx:334 vs 262).
Acceptable as an h2 but not as a separate row; fold into the aside heading (Explorer.tsx:335).

dataDensity.element: Incident title, status pill, classification pill
dataDensity.reason: Identity and geotech type at a glance (Explorer.tsx:336-337).
Provenance detail; show as the classification pill's tooltip/secondary line only when pending (Explorer.tsx:338).
Anchor for judging photo offsets; add copy action (Explorer.tsx:344).
Needed to compare against photo capture times (Explorer.tsx:345).
Replace with 'Affected area drawn / Not drawn'; the map legend already shows the geometry (Explorer.tsx:346).
The number duplicates the 'Open technical submission' button; keep only 'Not created yet' as an inline note when absent (Explorer.tsx:347, 359).

dataDensity.element: Photo summary tiles (Photos / Mapped / Heading / Unmapped)
dataDensity.reason: Instant evidence-coverage read; rename 'Heading' to 'With heading' (Explorer.tsx:350-354).
Long free text pushes the photo list down; collapse to two lines with 'More' (Explorer.tsx:356).

dataDensity.element: Action links (technical submission / Incidents / Event Group)
dataDensity.reason: The exits reviewers need; unify labels (Explorer.tsx:358-362).

dataDensity.element: Photo rows (thumbnail, file name, mapped, heading, captured)
dataDensity.reason: The evidence list itself; add correction/accuracy indicators (Explorer.tsx:366-384).
Move it inline under the tapped row with a dismiss, instead of above the map grid (Explorer.tsx:269, 374).

dataDensity.element: Fetched-but-hidden photo provenance (correction flags, accuracy, sources)
dataDensity.reason: Show a 'Corrected' pill and '±m' accuracy on rows; full source details in the popup (photoEvidenceApi.ts:3-30).
Standard GIS chrome; Home should target the current level's extent (GisMap.tsx:186-188).
Show only the layers populated in the current mode (GisMap.tsx:166-170, 191).
Explains the rule; needs a next-step link (Explorer.tsx:229-231).

quickWins: Stop the viewport reset: in GisMap.tsx:229-263 track the previous mode in a ref and call view.goTo(CALIFORNIA_EXTENT) only on entry to PROJECTS mode; on poll ticks leave the viewpoint alone.
Fix the phone toolbar overflow: change Explorer.tsx:242 to 'grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_auto] gap-2 w-full sm:max-w-[560px]' and add min-w-0 to the select.
Make the map height responsive: pass height='clamp(280px, 42vh, 420px)' below md via a matchMedia hook or a CSS variable with a media query, keeping the current clamp at md+ (Explorer.tsx:283).

Enable popup docking for narrow maps: popup: { dockEnabled: true, dockOptions: { breakpoint: { width: 768 }, position: 'bottom-center' } } and set the popup image to max-width:100% (GisMap.tsx:183, 329).
Complete the legends by generating chips from statusProjectColor/incidentColor and adding 'Selected Incident' in INCIDENT mode (GisMap.tsx:377-379).

Humanize popup and facts values: pass eventGroupStatusLabel/incidentStatusLabel/formatTimestamp into graphic attributes; replace 'Saved geometry: MultiPolygon' with 'Affected area drawn' (GisMap.tsx:243, 257, 284, 297, 333; Explorer.tsx:346).
Remove the two back buttons and the 'Selected Event Group' eyebrow; show the group location once (Explorer.tsx:310-313, 334).
